tokyo_gonpachi_asakusa_azumaba.price_note: No dish and no price — an honest empty reached after downloading everything the shop publishes. 権八 puts its entire menu online as FIVE PDFs (grand menu, weekday lunch, holiday lunch, drinks, party plans) and all five were fetched and run through a text extractor. Every one is a pure IMAGE SCAN: they yield between 1 and 10 characters each. Nothing — not a dish, not a price, not a section heading — is machine-readable in any of them. Tabelog not consulted: Cf-Mitigated: challenge (403) to this egress since 2026-09-02. ⚠ THIS IS NOW THE FOURTH OPERATOR IN THIS DATASET TO PUBLISH A COMPLETE MENU IN A FORM NO READER CAN USE, after RAKERU’s scanned grand menu, 俺の割烹’s bilingual PDF that lost its Japanese and every price, and ニューヨーカーズカフェ’s 1.8MB allergen table that extracts one character. The pattern is worth stating plainly: a restaurant that publishes a scan has disclosed nothing to anyone who cannot see the image — which includes screen-reader users and every automated allergen check, not only this project. ⚠ NOTHING ABOUT WHAT THIS KITCHEN SERVES IS RECORDED, deliberately. Gonpachi is a well-known izakaya brand and it would be easy to write down what such a place "obviously" has; that is exactly the reasoning this dataset forbids. Re-check if the operator ever publishes an HTML menu, or when Tabelog access returns.

tokyo_torinao.price_note: No dish and no price. The shop’s site is a JavaScript application — a Nuxt build whose served HTML contains the shop name, the Tawaramachi location and the page shell, and no menu content at all. Both the root and the /menu/ path were fetched directly and rendered through a text-extracting fetcher, and neither yields an item. Tabelog not consulted: Cf-Mitigated: challenge (403) to this egress since 2026-09-02. ⚠ NOTHING ABOUT WHAT THIS KITCHEN SERVES IS RECORDED, deliberately, and it is worth naming what is being withheld: 鳥 in the name means chicken, and a Japanese chicken restaurant turns on exactly one question a coeliac needs answered — タレ or 塩. A tare is soy, mirin and sugar, painted on during grilling and absorbed; salt is salt. That single distinction decides most of a yakitori board, and it is unanswerable from a page that renders nothing. Reading it off the shop name would be the error this dataset forbids. Re-check when the site serves HTML, or when Tabelog access returns.

tokyo_kayu_sanchin_okayu_to_me.price_note: ⚠ NO PRICES ARE RECORDED HERE AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: the operator publishes a full allergen table and a full nutrition table but no price list anywhere on its site, so every price below is deliberately empty rather than invented. What it does publish is worth far more than prices. The allergen sheet is dated 二〇二四年十二月更新 and is explicitly scoped to 「粥餐庁　京王モール、仙台エスパル店、KITTE博多店、札幌オーロラタウン店」 — the Keio Mall branch this record covers is named on it, so this is the right branch, not a chain-wide approximation. ⚠ THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT SINGLE FINDING IN THIS TICK AND IT INVERTS WHAT EVERYONE ASSUMES. Rice congee is the food people reach for when they are ill, when they are avoiding gluten, when they want the plainest possible thing in the bowl. At 粥餐庁 the PLAIN CONGEE BASE — 素かゆ, the bare porridge with nothing added — declares 小麦・乳成分・えび・大豆・鶏肉・豚肉. Wheat, milk AND shrimp are in the base itself. The sheet then says so explicitly: 「＊ベースのおかゆのみのアレルギーとなります。すべてのおかゆに含まれております」 — this applies to EVERY congee on the menu. There is no okayu here that a coeliac can eat, and no topping choice changes that, because the wheat is in the pot before anything is added. ⚠ THE REASON IS IN THE SHOP'S OWN DESCRIPTION, WHICH IS WHY THIS IS WORTH UNDERSTANDING RATHER THAN JUST RECORDING. Chinese congee is not Japanese okayu. The shop explains that 中国粥 is cooked from raw rice in boiling STOCK rather than water — 「毎朝熱々の自家製スープで生米から毎日じっくり炊き上げる」 — so the porridge is built on a house soup, and that soup is where the chicken, pork, shrimp and wheat come from. The 粥たれ served with it is separately described as カキとカツオと昆布, oyster, bonito and kombu. A Japanese okayu is rice and water; this is rice and broth, and the difference is the whole answer. ⚠ THE VEGAN TRAP IS JUST AS SHARP: ８種野菜のベジかゆ, the eight-vegetable "veggie congee", declares 乳成分・えび・鶏肉・豚肉 — milk, shrimp, chicken and pork. A dish named for being vegetable-based contains four animal ingredients, because it inherits the same stock. ⚠ THE NOODLES ARE NOT AN ESCAPE EITHER, AND ONE WORD ON THE SITE WILL MISLEAD PEOPLE: the shop advertises 全粒粉麺, wholemeal noodles. Wholemeal is wheat. Every noodle dish declares 卵・小麦, and 濃厚ごま担々麺 adds 落花生 (peanut). ⚠ WHAT IS ACTUALLY CLEAN, BY THE SHOP'S OWN TABLE, IS A SHORT LIST AND IT IS ALL SIDES AND DRINKS: 青菜 and みょうが・三つ葉・パクチー are marked 「アレルギーは含まれておりません」 outright, 鮭 declares さけ only, 杏仁豆腐 declares 乳成分・大豆 with no wheat, and ウーロン茶, ジャスミン茶 and コーヒー declare nothing at all. ⚠ AND THE SHEET CARRIES TWO WARNINGS THAT MATTER: 「また調理器具は同一のものを使用しております」 — the same cooking equipment is used throughout — and the 肉まん lines add 「＊卵・えび・かに・いか・ゼラチンが混入している可能性があります」, a declared possibility of cross-contamination with egg, shrimp, crab, squid and gelatin. The chain dates to a 1967 founding philosophy of 医食同源 and opened as 謝朋殿 粥餐庁 in Shinjuku in March 2001; the congee is a 白米2:玄米1 blend.

tokyo_mita_seimenjo_suidobashi.price_note: PARTIAL FOR ONE SPECIFIC REASON: 三田製麺所's official menu page names and describes every item on the card but prints NO PRICES ANYWHERE — not on the category page and not on the top page. The item list below is therefore complete and first-party, and the price field is deliberately empty on every row rather than filled from a third party. The dataset's own menu_url for this record points at Tabelog, which this egress cannot reach (Cloudflare challenge since 2026-09-02), so no price cross-check was possible. Anyone with Tabelog access can fill the prices in without re-doing the item work. Note also that mita-seimen.com/en/2018/07/13/shop_29_suidoubashi/ — the URL this dataset carries as the shop's website — now 404s; the chain has restructured its site and the branch page no longer exists at that path, so the record is keyed to the chain menu. ⚠ THIS IS A TSUKEMEN SPECIALIST AND IT IS A FLAT NO FOR A COELIAC. The shop's name literally means "Mita noodle factory"; the whole proposition is thick wheat 極太麺. Beyond the noodles, the tsukejiru is a 豚骨魚介 pork-and-fish broth built on soy tare, and the 油そば range is described by the shop as 濃厚な醤油ダレ — soy sauce, hence wheat. The one item below that is not noodle-based, 金賞唐揚げ, is kara-age, which is flour- or starch-dusted and fried; the shop does not say which, and the fryer is shared.

tokyo_udagawa_naru.price_note: NEARLY AN EMPTY, AND THE ONE ITEM BELOW IS PROSE RATHER THAN A MENU. ウダガワ 成ル's official site is a single WordPress page carrying the address (渋谷区宇田川町6-20 パラシオン渋谷1F), the phone (03-3461-1166), hours 17:30–23:00, 定休日 不定休, a Google map and an Instagram embed that returns 投稿はありません — no posts. There is no menu page, no PDF, no price list and no 品書き anywhere on the site; the nav is HOME / GOOGLE MAP / OFFICIAL only. The single dish recorded below is named in the shop's own descriptive paragraph, not on a menu, and carries no price — it is included because it is genuinely first-party evidence of what the kitchen serves, and excluded from any price claim. The shop's sister venues (氣ウラ, 巖 渋谷, ミヤシタ成ル) are separate records and their pages were not used here. The dataset's menu_url points at Tabelog, which this egress cannot reach. ⚠ WHAT THE SITE DOES TELL A COELIAC: the shop describes itself as 鉄板焼き — teppanyaki — with 和食をベースにしたさまざまな一品料理 and a large regional sake list. A teppan is a single shared steel plate on which soy-based sauces are used all evening, which is about the least separable cooking surface there is. Treat the whole venue as ask-at-best and expect no allergen sheet.

items.note: ⚠ Named by the shop as its 日替わりの (daily-changing) teppanyaki item. Japanese dashimaki is seasoned with 白だし or めんつゆ, both soy-sauce products and therefore wheat, and the dashi itself is bonito — so this is both a gluten fact and a non-vegan one. Price not published.

tokyo_sacya_shibuya_scramble_s.price_note: SACYA'S SITE IS LIVE AND PUBLISHES NO MENU. Both the Shibuya Scramble Square shop page and the company's /cafe/ index were fetched and read in full: they give the address (B2F, Shibuya Scramble Square, 2-24-12 Shibuya) and postcode and nothing else about what is served — no drink list, no prices, no PDF, no allergen note. The /menu/ path was probed and 404s. The site's ONLINE STORE panel reads 「coming soon.」 and its store.sacya.jp link was not used, because a retail bean/leaf shop is not this café's counter menu and quoting it here would attach the wrong prices to the record. The company's other listed location, SACYA 代官山, is explicitly marked 「※現在リニューアルに向けて閉業中」 — closed for renovation — which is a useful signal that the site IS maintained, and therefore that the absence of a menu is a choice rather than neglect. The dataset's menu_url is Tabelog, unreachable from this egress. SACYA is recorded as a matcha specialty café; a matcha stand is a genuinely promising GF and vegan candidate (whisked tea is neither wheat nor dairy, and plant milks are common), so this record is worth finishing when a menu source appears — but nothing has been established here.

tokyo_tempura_shinjuku_tsunaha.price_note: つな八'S OWN PAGE FOR 総本店別館 WAS FETCHED AND READ IN FULL AND IT DESCRIBES ITS COURSES WITHOUT NAMING OR PRICING THEM — the course titles and the per-course prices are set as images, so what survives as text is the composition of each course and nothing else. Those compositions are recorded below verbatim because they are genuinely useful (they tell you how many fried items and of what kind), but no course here has a name or a price and none has been invented. The only figures on the page are 平均予算: 2,500円 at lunch and 5,000円 at dinner. 総本店別館 is 新宿3-28-4 TRES SHINJUKU 6F・B1F, open 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00), 35 seats on 6F and 34 in the basement, all non-smoking. Lunch courses run to 15:00 (L.O. 15:00) per a 2026/07/07 notice. ⚠ THE ONE PIECE OF REAL ALLERGEN INFORMATION ON THE WHOLE SITE IS THE FRYING OIL, AND IT IS FIRST-PARTY: 「天ぷら新宿つな八 の天ぷら油は創業以来ヘルシーなごま油を使用しています」 — the shop has fried in SESAME OIL since it was founded. Sesame is one of Japan's statutory allergen items and this is a whole-restaurant, every-dish fact, so anyone with a sesame allergy cannot eat here at all. It is the single most valuable line recovered from this record. ⚠ THE /calorie/ PAGE IS NOT AN ALLERGEN TABLE. It exists, it is titled カロリー情報, and its actual table is an image; the page's only readable content is the sesame-oil sentence and a citation to a 2009 Takahashi Shoten calorie dictionary. ⚠ TEMPURA IS WHEAT AND THERE IS NO VERSION OF THIS MEAL THAT IS NOT. Every course is a run of items fried in a wheat-flour-and-egg batter in shared oil, and the 天つゆ served with it is dashi, mirin and soy sauce — so each course is recorded no on both axes. お揃い at the end of each composition is the rice, miso soup and pickles that close a tempura course; the miso soup is dashi-based and the pickles are usually soy-cured.
